queries.name: firstUpdateChildren
queries.sql: SELECT name,depth,dur/1e6 AS ms FROM slice WHERE parent_id=(SELECT id FROM slice WHERE track_id=0 AND name='Scene::Update' AND dur>=0 ORDER BY dur DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY dur DESC LIMIT 20

queries.name: trackingChildren
queries.sql: SELECT c.name,COUNT(*) AS calls,SUM(c.dur)/1e9 AS total_seconds,AVG(c.dur)/1e6 AS mean_ms,MAX(c.dur)/1e6 AS max_ms FROM slice c JOIN slice p ON c.parent_id=p.id WHERE p.track_id=0 AND p.name='Track' AND c.dur>=0 GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_seconds DESC LIMIT 15

queries.name: majorSpans
queries.sql: SELECT name,COUNT(*) AS calls,AVG(dur)/1e6 AS mean_ms,MAX(dur)/1e6 AS max_ms FROM slice WHERE track_id=0 AND dur>=0 AND name IN ('Track','Scene::Update','RenderFrame') GROUP BY name
